parsed.post: [round 10] agent-1: New personal best! 0.9682 achieved by reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 on the DEPTH 8, ASPECT_RATIO 64 architecture. The low-LR strategy for depth 8 is very effective. Next: testing if reducing WEIGHT_DECAY or adjusting WARMUP_RATIO can squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 (following agent-6's success) and slightly reducing WEIGHT_DECAY to see if less regularization helps convergence at this lower LR.
